authority: cross-layer projection only; canonical facts remain in referenced owners
purpose: Project the same body/anatomy objects through Life & Body, House, Axis, Religion, Science and Corporium without duplicating ownership. An object keeps one identity while each surface asks a different typed question.
projection_law: Objects are join points; pages are views.
Anatomical identity never changes when viewed through a symbolic or religious lens.
Historical tradition meaning is described before project comparison.
Project symbolism may attach to several biological neighbors without turning any into scientific identity.
Every projection points back to a canonical owner and to the Life & Body reader when a biological object is involved.

projections.anatomy: Paired diencephalic nuclear system bordering the third ventricle; sensory, motor, attention, memory, arousal and recurrent thalamocortical functions.
projections.project: Father's House / inner Potato; nuclei as rooms; TRN as wall/gate.
projections.history: Thalamus carries an 'inner chamber' naming history from Greek anatomical tradition.
projections.tradition: John 14 Father's-House comparison belongs to Christian/project comparison; Horus-brain overlay is a separate modern hypothesis.

projections.anatomy: Narrow CSF-filled midline ventricular cavity within the diencephalon.
projections.project: Inner Court / shared chamber between House, Steward and posterior Door region.
projections.systems: Part of ventricular CSF route toward the cerebral aqueduct.

projections.anatomy: Midline epithalamic neuroendocrine organ producing rhythmic melatonin.
projections.systems: Retina→SCN→PVN→upper thoracic sympathetic route→superior cervical ganglion→pineal forms a real descent-and-return timing circuit.
projections.project: Son-side Door / Single Eye / timing threshold.
projections.history: Pineal soul/third-eye interpretations belong to history of ideas and later esoteric reception, not modern anatomical proof.

projections.anatomy: 33 conventional vertebral elements contain/relate to a 31-segment neural system; cord tissue ends near L1–L2 while roots continue below.
projections.systems: Ascending, descending, autonomic, reflex and local spinal circuits form a multiplex vertical communication architecture.
projections.project: Ladder / Axis with 33 bony Rooms and five broader project spinal Gates.
projections.tradition: Chakra/nāḍī overlays are historical/subtle-body comparators rather than spinal anatomy.

projections.anatomy: CSF occupies ventricles and subarachnoid spaces around brain, cord and cauda-equina roots; adult central canal is not the main spinal CSF route.
projections.systems: Production, circulation, exchange and drainage are distinct processes involving choroid plexus, ventricular/subarachnoid spaces and drainage interfaces.
projections.project: River / Spirit-flow comparator; strongest as one layer within a wider multi-flow organism.

projections.anatomy: Vascular epithelial interface producing much CSF and maintaining the blood–CSF barrier.
projections.systems: A living production/transport/immune boundary, not passive plumbing.

projections.anatomy: Bilateral longitudinal chains of paravertebral ganglia beside the vertebral column.
projections.systems: Permit sympathetic traffic to synapse locally, ascend, descend or pass toward prevertebral ganglia.
projections.tradition: Useful modern comparator for paired side-channel imagery, but they do not spiral like caduceus serpents and are not proven iḍā/piṅgalā.

projections.anatomy: Cranial nerve X carries extensive visceral afferent information toward medullary NTS and parasympathetic output back to organs.
projections.project: Return road / inward-report stream, without making vagus the sole mind-body channel.

projections.anatomy: Vestibular gravity/head-motion information participates in thalamic, retrosplenial, entorhinal and hippocampal navigation networks; anterior thalamus contributes to head-direction coding.
projections.project: Orientation Room / biological neighbor for Axis and North language.
projections.systems: Heading is computed relative to multisensory/environmental frames.
projections.boundary: Not a sacred or magnetic-North detector.

projections.tradition: Ancient Wedjat: restored/healed Eye of Horus associated with soundness, protection, regeneration and rebirth.
projections.history: Sagittal-brain/Eye-of-Horus overlays are modern speculative comparisons, not demonstrated ancient neuroanatomy.
projections.project: Restored Eye / wholeness can be compared with House/Eye architecture while keeping the historical lanes separate.

projections.tradition: Hermes is messenger, boundary/travel figure and psychopomp; caduceus is his heraldic staff with later paired-serpent form.
projections.project: Messenger / boundary / passage comparator for Door and Axis.
projections.history: Caduceus, kundalini, sympathetic trunks and DNA are separate lineages; modern overlays must be labelled as such.

projections.tradition: South Asian subtle-body systems vary in cakra count, channels, deities, mantras and kundalini dynamics.
projections.history: Plexus/endocrine/spinal identifications become especially prominent in modern physiological reinterpretations.
projections.anatomy: Nearby plexuses, autonomic chains, spinal pathways and endocrine organs can be compared without becoming the historical cakras.
projections.project: Five spinal Gates + higher Eye/Crown centers are a Potatoverse model, not an ancient universal map.
Crown is upper orientation; House is deep thalamic architecture; Ladder is spinal/vertical route; above-Crown remains project symbolism.
projections.anatomy: Thalamus is not at the physical crown. Brainstem/foramen-magnum continuity joins spinal cord to intracranial systems.
projections.systems: Vertical orientation becomes branched/recurrent inside the skull rather than one straight tube.
projections.tradition: Sahasrāra/crown imagery is a subtle-body comparator, not a thalamic anatomical label.

projections.anatomy: Neural plate/tube regionalizes into forebrain, midbrain, hindbrain and spinal cord; progenitor lineages, migration and tract growth produce adult structures.
projections.systems: Adult brain rooms inherit developmental lineage and geometry but are remodeled by migration, connectivity and maturation.
projections.project: Useful for explaining how one continuous Axis differentiates into many adult rooms without claiming embryology encodes theology.

projections.anatomy: Endothelium, pericytes, astrocytes, neurons, microglia and extracellular matrix interact to maintain barrier, metabolism and local blood-flow coupling.
projections.systems: A living boundary is maintained by cooperating cell types rather than one wall material.
projections.project: Better biological neighbor for House wall/boundary imagery than a passive shell.

projections.anatomy: Cortex is layered and contains many excitatory, inhibitory and non-neuronal cell classes with area-specific molecular and projection patterns.
projections.systems: Thalamocortical input and corticothalamic feedback form recurrent House↔cortex loops across layers.
projections.project: Turns broad cortical 'rooms' into nested cellular rooms while keeping the navigation metaphor separate from cytoarchitecture.
